source: blender/fauna/*.py (procedural geometry, rigs and painted textures, headless Blender 5.2) + blender/fauna/pack_fauna.mjs

conventions.axes: glTF: +Y up, +Z = the animal's forward (head direction), +X = the animal's left
conventions.skinning: every model is ONE skinned mesh (SkinnedMesh) with its armature; clone instances with SkeletonUtils.clone() (three/addons/utils/SkeletonUtils.js), not Object3D.clone()
conventions.clips: in-place loops (the root never travels): AnimationMixer + LoopRepeat; the last key equals the first, so loops are seamless. Every clip keys every bone (T/R/S), so switching clips never leaves a bone in a stale pose; crossFadeTo() ~0.2-0.4 s between clips
conventions.materials: metallicRoughness PBR; baseColor ETC1S KTX2 (sRGB), ORM ETC1S KTX2 (G = roughness, B = metal = 0, R = 1, no AO); swan also has a UASTC normal map
conventions.loaders: GLTFLoader + KTX2Loader + MeshoptDecoder (EXT_meshopt_compression, KHR_mesh_quantization, KHR_texture_basisu), as for the other models

swan.name: Mute swan
swan.origin: centre of the floating footprint ON THE WATERLINE: put the origin at the water surface (y = 0 is the water); the hull and webbed feet below y = 0 are meant to be seen through clear water

clips.name: swim
clips.note: paddle loop: body bob 4 mm at 1 Hz (one stroke per foot per loop), slight neck sway, head looks around; feet paddle alternately under water

clips.name: preen
clips.note: starts and ends exactly in the swim pose (crossfade ~0.3 s either way); neck reaches back to the left wing at 1.5 s, nibbles 1.6-4.4 s, returns by 6 s

notes: Single material (white plumage atlas incl. bill, lores, eye and feet) with a 512 UASTC normal map for the feather detail; roughness from the ORM texture (G).
Mute swans hold the wings folded; there is no flight rig. Drift the root yourself (~0.1-0.3 m/s) and yaw slowly toward the heading.
Size: 1.25 m tail-to-bill along Z with the neck raised in an S (a typical adult, ~1.5 m when stretched); head top 0.71 m above the water. Scale 1.12 if you want exactly 1.4 m floating length.

trout.name: Brown trout
trout.origin: body centre (mid length, mid depth); snout at z = +0.175, caudal fin tip at z = -0.175

clips.name: swim
clips.note: one tail beat per second, traveling wave head -> tail (S-bend grows toward the tail), slight recoil yaw of the head; use timeScale 1-3 for faster swimming

notes: Skinned spine (spine1 root -> head forward, spine2..spine4 -> tail backward), so the clip plays with a plain AnimationMixer.

Shader alternative for many instances (no skinning): bend amount t = clamp((0.175 - position.z) / 0.35, 0, 1) from the local position, x += A * t^2 * sin(2*pi*(f*time - 0.9*t)) with A ~ 0.03 m; no vertex attribute is needed.
Seen mostly from above through water: the back is dark olive with black spots; red spots sit along and under the lateral line.

kingfisher.name: Common kingfisher
kingfisher.origin: body centre in the flight posture (bind pose = horizontal body)

clips.name: fly
clips.note: whirring wingbeat, 0.12 s loop (~8 Hz); folded wings and feet scaled to ~0 (tucked)

clips.name: perch
clips.note: 2 s loop: upright body (~45 deg), folded wings shown, flight wings scaled to ~0 into the shoulder, feet down; quick head turns and one tail bob

notes: ALWAYS play a clip: the bind pose shows both the spread flight wings and the folded wings (each clip hides one set by bone scale).
perchGrip = the toes in the perch pose (creature space). To sit the bird on a twig: bird.position = twigTop - perchGrip (rotated by the bird yaw).

swallow.name: Barn swallow
swallow.origin: body centre; bill tip z = +0.066, streamer tips z = -0.112

clips.name: fly
clips.note: 1.0 s loop: two 0.25 s wingbeats then a 0.5 s glide with the fork opening slightly

clips.name: glide
clips.note: 1.0 s loop, wings held with slight sweep, gentle roll

notes: Fast, low swoops over the water with sharp banks; bank the root into turns (roll up to ~50 deg).

dragonfly.name: Emperor dragonfly (male)
dragonfly.origin: thorax centre (the wing hinges); head at z = +0.0135, abdomen tip at z = -0.064

clips.name: hover
clips.note: 0.05 s wingbeat loop (20 Hz), hindwings lead the forewings by a quarter cycle

clips.name: rest
clips.note: wings held flat and still (perched or gliding)

notes: Two materials: dragonfly_body (opaque) and dragonfly_wings (alphaMode BLEND, double sided, shares the RGBA atlas; veins in alpha).
At 60 fps a 20 Hz beat aliases into a few frozen wing positions: give every instance mixer.timeScale = 0.9-1.1 (random) so the wings read as a shimmer, not a strobe.
Flight: darts in straight lines with sudden stops and hovers; keep the body level, add a 1-3 mm root bob at 2-4 Hz in code.
